name: Fonds Landschaft Schweiz (FLS)
summary: Federally financed Swiss fund giving non-repayable contributions for voluntary measures that keep near-natural cultural landscapes, such as hedges, orchards, dry-stone walls and stream renaturation, with set submission dates.

status.quote: Der FLS nimmt Beitragsgesuche in digitaler Form mit einem entsprechenden Projektdossier an info@fls-fsp.ch entgegen.
